What is Junkflash?\nJunkflash is a new way to access celebrity news. The Junkflash browser add-in recognizes and tags up celebrities you come across while browsing. When you point at a celebrity name a sidebar appears showing the latest published headlines about that person. These are aggregated from the feeds of 50 top celebrity news sites.

Why is it cool?\nJunkflash users doesn't have to search sites or clear out feeds to find gossip they’re interested in, Junkflash brings relevant celebrity news to the context of your browsing. When shopping for movies or music, watching clips on YouTube or reading a movie review and a celebrity is mentioned, Junkflash shows you the latest gossip about that person right there and then!

And when you're already at a celebrity news site, Junkflash lets you see other sites angle on a story, or more recent developments.

“Junkflash brings gossip closer to gossip fans.”

Has anyone else here run into this and did you find a work-around?
